Platforms.heading: Turn these materials into reusable content assets

PainPoints.heading: Companies do not need another AI copywriting box
PainPoints.subheading: They need materials, expertise, cases, and customer questions organized so every content task can reuse assets.
PainPoints.pain1Desc: Company docs, product manuals, project reviews, and sales Q&A live in separate files and chats.
PainPoints.pain2Title: Founder Expertise Is Hard to Copy
PainPoints.pain2Desc: The sharpest judgment and sales language sits in the founder's head, not in the team's workflow.
PainPoints.pain2StatLabel: From personal skill to company asset
PainPoints.pain3Desc: Strong product advantages often read like jargon, so customers do not feel the value.
PainPoints.pain4Desc: Repeated concerns are not converted into standard answers for content, sales, and support.

HowItWorks.heading: From materials to content assets
HowItWorks.subheading: No complex architecture talk. Teams record materials, generate content, review quality, shoot, and reuse.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Bring in company materials, founder know-how, project cases, selling points, customer Q&A, and viral references.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Organize pain points, proof, scenarios, language, and conversion goals into reusable assets.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: AIM separates light edits, new writing, topic positioning, and review so small edits do not drift.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Produce topics, spoken scripts, deep master drafts, shooting briefs, and private-domain follow-up language.
HowItWorks.step5Desc: Check for AI taste, drift, and weak proof. Confirmed language can be saved back for reuse.

Features.heading: AIM compresses complex content work into clear capabilities
Features.subheading: Users see simple business actions. AIM decides when to use the knowledge base, viral references, and quality gates.
Features.feature1Desc: When users only need a sentence or paragraph improved, AIM keeps the original intent and avoids unnecessary knowledge lookup.
Features.feature2Desc: Turn founder recordings, long notes, opinions, and cases into reusable long-form master drafts.
Features.feature3Desc: Match customer stories, product strengths, and viral references to find the right IP content direction.
Features.feature4Desc: Extract viewpoint structure, hooks, and rhythm from strong videos, then translate them into the customer's own voice.
Features.feature5Desc: Check for AI taste, drift, weak proof, and loose logic before the content goes out.
Features.feature6Desc: Save confirmed expressions, topics, and scripts back into the library so the next draft gets sharper.

UseCases.heading: Content delivery scenarios AIM fits
UseCases.subheading: AIM starts from the content jobs companies run most often, not from a long feature list.
UseCases.case1Desc: Turn origin stories, deal experience, and industry judgment into pinned videos, spoken opinions, and trust content.
UseCases.case2Desc: Turn founder expertise, customer questions, and store projects into spoken scripts and sales language.
UseCases.case3Desc: Translate solutions, advantages, and industry pain points into language customers understand.
UseCases.case4Desc: Turn frequent objections and Q&A into consistent, reusable deal language.

Stats.heading: AIM does not generate once. It compounds assets.

Testimonials.heading: Loved by Business Owners
Testimonials.t1Quote: Our cases used to sit in folders. Now every project can become topics, spoken scripts, and sales material.
Testimonials.t2Quote: We no longer start every script from scratch. AIM organizes language around our selling points and customer questions.
Testimonials.t3Quote: Our team can finally write in my voice because the system carries my thinking into the copy.

Differentiators.heading: Why it is not a normal AI writing tool
Differentiators.subheading: Writing tools create one piece. AIM compounds a reusable content asset system.
Differentiators.diff0Desc: Light edit tasks only use the draft, selection, and edit request by default instead of stuffing in the knowledge base.
Differentiators.diff1Desc: Materials, expertise, cases, selling points, Q&A, and viral references are organized before they are called.
Differentiators.diff2Desc: Output is based on real cases and real customer questions, not generic templates.
Differentiators.diff3Desc: AIM borrows the viewpoint, hook, and rhythm of strong videos, then rewrites through the customer's own stories.
Differentiators.diff4Desc: Content is designed around trust, pain, proof, objections, and action.
Differentiators.diff5Desc: Founder judgment, tone, and language become a capability the team can call.
Differentiators.diff6Desc: Every script can be checked across editing quality, AI taste, hook strength, and logic.
